Premium users get extra coins every win!

games.name: Family Zone
games.desc:

Team up with Duck Duck to earn the FREE Duck-O-Lantern head! Find Nerba, hunt for hidden ducks, and finish the quests by November 4.

- Take on short, playful co-op challenges together 🎮
- Complete objectives to earn FREE UGC 🎁
- Learn how Roblox works and how to stay safe 🛡️

Play together, learn together, stay safe together. Grab a partner and start playing! 🎉

Made by the Roblox Education team with the help of MindTrust.

games.desc:

games.name: SCP: Roleplay
games.desc:
Help protect a top-secret research facility or raid it and free all the anomalies!

🔥 Escape or raid the facility and free SCP anomalies
🧪 Study strange creatures
🛡️ Keep the SCPs contained and protect the facility

Play as a Prisoner (Class - D), Scientist, Guard, and unlock more teams as you progress.
Climb through the ranks, make discoveries, and help protect the world from the unknown. 

Secure. Contain. Protect.

(Licensing Attributions can be found on the Roblox devforum "scp-roleplay-game-rules")

games.name: Control Europe

🌍 Control Europe

Pick any modern European country and start your conquest!
⚔️ Capture cities, grow your army, and crush your enemies.

games.name: SKI (ALPHA)
games.desc:
*BETA*

SKI is a hardcore, fast-paced skiing game.

Reaching the bottom isn’t easy,learn the controls, keep your speed, and avoid crashing.

Race friends, find the fastest lines, send huge jumps, land tricks, and chase world records. Every mistake costs time.

🎿 CONTROLS
WASD / Arrow Keys / Left Stick — Ski
Space / A — Jump
Scroll / Pinch / Right Stick — Change Camera

🔥 TRICKS
Keyboard — Double Tap WASD / Q or E
Mobile — Swipe right side / Hold or Double Tap Jump
Controller — D-Pad / X

Private server owners can change course length and difficulty from the top bar.

👍 Like and favorite for new skis, features, and updates

games.name: Shrink Hide & Seek
games.desc:
Shrink Hide & Seek is a combination of hide and seek and the ability to shrink! 

🤏 AS HIDER: Shrink and hide inside objects. Use powers and trolls to distract the seekers. DON’T GET CAUGHT!

games.name: Hide and Seek Extreme
games.desc:
Welcome to Hide and Seek Extreme.
At the start of the game, one player gets chosen to be 'It'. 'It' has to try and find the other players. 'It' will not spawn with their default character, instead they will spawn with their equipped 'It' character. Every 'It' character has a special ability that can be used to help catch the hiders. 'It' characters can be purchased in the shop.

Press 1 to use your 'It' ability
Press T to taunt

Experience life deep within the world’s lush rainforests in Jungle Life, the ultimate wild survival adventure. Rule the undergrowth as a fierce tiger 🐅 with unmatched power.
